summary: MANNHULLET (org. no. 991 538 836) is an association (FLI) based in Trondheim, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2007-08-23. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 94.992 (Aktiviteter i andre medlemsorganisasjoner ellers); it has 0 registered employees. Board chair: Sigurd Sangolt Thomle.
